about: Cratarr's page addresses, one table (the owner, 2026-11-02: one address a page, a coherent and robust whole): the page's lib/addresses, the server's links back to the page and the app's each checked against it by their tests. An address is `#/<page>`, then after `?` the panel's words (what it views, on which tab) and the page's own; no address, or one no page has, is Home's. Change it here and in all three.
